purpose: Independent chained physical-amount replay of every saved executed episode, plus a fixed subset of selected causal policy tails.

numerics.volume: Analytic within every interval and at every endpoint

selected_tail_subset.scenarios: all saved finite scenarios at each selected stage
selected_tail_subset.selection: Manifest order only; no outcome-based inclusion or exclusion

classification.actual: Recompute exact terminal and physical classifications using declared physical tolerances; classify operational success separately from controller failure.
classification.inner_gate: Retain every inner optimization-band label discrepancy as an audit qualification, including numerical boundary flips.
classification.design: Independently test the stated outer design band; an inner-band flip is not itself an outer-band violation.
classification.failed_episodes: Retain failures in the assigned denominator and replay available completed prefix without relabelling the episode successful.
classification.overall: passed requires no failures and no qualifications; numerical assurance is empirical, not a rigorous enclosure or a continuous-uncertainty proof.
